item.title: Local Roundup: Lake-Lehman girls rout Wyoming Area in season finale
item.description: Kinley Purdy knocked down four 3-pointers and led all scorers with 23 points as Lake-Lehman defeated Wyoming Area 63-37 to wrap up Division 2 action in Wyoming Valley Conference girls basketball on Tuesday night.

item.title: Americans sweep Group A with dominating 5-0 win over Canada
item.description: MILAN — Hannah Bilka scored twice, and the United States’ youth and speed overwhelmed a Canadian women’s hockey team missing its captain in a 5-0 win at the Milan Cortina Games on Tuesday.

item.title: Wilkes-Barre City Council approves borrowing up to $8M to restructure debt, fund infrastructure work
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — City Council, during a combined work session/regular meeting on Tuesday, approved borrowing up to $8 million through a bond issuance to restructure outstanding debt and help pay for future infrastructure work.

item.title: Familiar foes meet in WVC boys semifinals
item.description: Holy Redeemer’s buzzer-beating layup on Saturday afternoon against Hanover Area sent the Royals back to the Wyoming Valley Conference Boys Basketball Tournament.

item.title: Hanover Area School Board approves elementary center project recommendations
item.description: The Hanover Area school board approved recommendations relating to the Hanover Area Elementary Center project at a board meeting on Tuesday.

item.title: Luzerne County Council allocates additional $850,000 in American Rescue funds to airport
item.description: Luzerne County Council unanimously agreed Tuesday to allocate an additional $850,000 in American Rescue Plan Act funding to the county-owned Wyoming Valley Airport in Forty Fort and Wyoming, increasing the total earmark to $8.3 million.

item.title: Shootings at school and home in northeastern British Columbia leave 10 dead, including shooter
item.description: VANCOUVER, Canada — A shooting at a school in British Columbia left eight dead including the suspect, with two more people found dead at a home believed to be connected to the incident, Canadian authorities said Tuesday.

item.title: Dallas School District lands $3.5 million federal grant to fund field house improvements
item.description: The Dallas School District school board announced at a meeting on Monday that the district was awarded a $3.5 million federal grant to fund field house improvements as part of the district’s Community Wellness Center project.

item.title: Editorial: Northeast Pennsylvania recently lost a titan
item.description: A Sunday tribute to Howard Grossman may have made him sound larger than life. The career advocate of our region’s potential died Jan. 26 at the age of 91, evoking sweeping praise for diverse reasons.

item.title: Commentary: War for Independence was ‘the people’s war’
item.description: Thomas Paine’s “Common Sense” may have persuaded the American colonists of the need for independence, but it is one thing to favor independence and quite another to pick up arms to obtain it.
